title: AxM
script:
-- Configuration
_G.FastPunchActive = true
local SPEED_MULTIPLIER = 1.6 -- Speed up the strike animation frame scaling

-- Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

task.spawn(function()
    print("👊 Mystic Battleground Fast Punch Engine Initialized.")
    
    while _G.FastPunchActive do
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if humanoid then
            local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            if animator then
                -- Scan actively playing combat animation tracks
                for _, track in pairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                    local name = track.Name:lower()
                    -- Target M1 punch sequences, light attacks, and strike combos
                    if name:find("punch") or name:find("hit") or name:find("attack") or name:find("m1") or track.Animation.AnimationId:find("rbxassetid") then
                        
                        -- 1. Scale up the animation playback speed
                        track:AdjustSpeed(SPEED_MULTIPLIER)
                        
                        -- 2. Animation Cancel: Skip the ending lag of the animation frame
                        if track.TimePosition > (track.Length * 0.55) then
                            track:Stop() -- Forces the combo state machine to advance to the next hit instantly
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        RunService.RenderStepped:Wait() -- High frequency verification frame rate
    end
    print("❌ Fast Punch Script Stopped.")
end)
